fixes.find: A City & Suburban technician starts in the room that is complaining and works back along its branch. Readings at the register and at the air handler set the scope before anything is opened. How long the visit takes depends on access and the number of joints opened. Sealing seams, re-securing a dropped branch and swapping a length of flex are reachable repairs where the run is exposed in a basement or crawlspace. Work behind finished plaster, or a fitting that must be fabricated for an odd gravity trunk, needs a second trip. The written price comes before the work, and same-day appointments are available when the schedule allows.
fixes.replace: A useful duct repair visit starts in the room that is complaining and works back along its branch. Readings at the register and at the air handler should set the scope before anything is opened. How long the visit takes depends on access and the number of joints opened. On an exposed basement or crawlspace run, sealing seams, re-securing a dropped branch and swapping flex are reachable repairs. Work behind finished plaster, or a fitting that must be fabricated for an odd gravity trunk, may need a second trip. City & Suburban gives a written price before the work, and same-day appointments are available when the schedule allows.
fixes.why: CRITICAL: unregistered diagnostic sequence recast as what a useful visit includes; READ-01 sentence shortened

fixes.find: Warning signs include a sooty draft hood, heavy window condensation near the appliance, and a carbon monoxide alarm that sounds only while the blower runs. Illinois requires carbon monoxide alarms near sleeping areas under the Carbon Monoxide Alarm Detector Act (430 ILCS 135). If an alarm sounds, the household should leave and call 911 and the gas utility first.
fixes.replace: Warning signs include a sooty draft hood and heavy window condensation near the appliance. A carbon monoxide alarm, even one that sounds only while the blower runs, means leaving the building first and calling 911 from outside, then the gas utility. Illinois requires carbon monoxide alarms near sleeping areas under the Carbon Monoxide Alarm Detector Act (430 ILCS 135).
fixes.why: Safety rule: CO alarm instruction is to leave the building and call 911 from outside

fixes.find: Three things, in order. Airflow at the repaired register improves the same day. The temperature spread between rooms evens out over a day or two as the building catches up. Runtime depends on the heat load as well as duct losses, so a sealed system asks the furnace for fewer minutes on the same cold night. A duct system that no longer leaks also loads its air filter more slowly, which keeps static pressure down. Rooms that were starved stop being the reason the thermostat is pushed higher. City & Suburban stands behind duct repair with a satisfaction guarantee.
fixes.replace: Results depend on the home, so measure rather than assume. Where access allows, airflow at the repaired register can be read before and after the repair, so the change is documented. The temperature spread between rooms may narrow, but branch length, returns and insulation also affect balance. Runtime depends on the heat load as well as duct losses, so sealing can reduce furnace minutes on a cold night, though the saving varies. A return side that leaks less can also load the air filter more slowly. If a room stays starved after the repair, the remaining restriction needs its own diagnosis. City & Suburban diagnoses before quoting any further work.
fixes.why: MAJOR: outcome and time promises replaced with measured before/after airflow; unapproved satisfaction guarantee removed
